items.title: Agent One - Agent Workers
items.description: Self-scaffolding and self-evaluating agent platform — describe a task in plain language and it builds purpose-built agents, assigns a role, accesses MCP tools, via Ollama locally or through Gemini. Checks its own responses and learns which models perform best.
